title: Museum labels
bodyMd: A museum replaced labels that named only donors with labels describing how objects had been acquired. Some visitors found the new labels less celebratory. The curator replied that recognizing a gift and examining its history are compatible activities. She retained donor names but added cases where ownership had been disputed. The display did not claim that every donation had a disputed history.
